composer.lessonHint: The learner opens it in the course library. It counts as done once they finish it there, so nothing is tracked twice.
composer.gameHint: Runs sandboxed, with no access to the learner app. A game reports its score by posting
composer.gameHint2: to its parent. The server clamps that score to the task's maximum and, because the page reports its own number, caps what it can contribute to the leaderboard.

composer.hideResultHint: Learners see that their answer is in, but not whether it was right — so the first to answer can't pass it around before the reveal. The bonus points land at reveal too, since an early bonus would give it away just as clearly.

settings.title: Daily Engagement
settings.subtitle: How the home-page tasks behave for every learner in this institute.
settings.loadHint: A learner in several batches could otherwise face a dozen tasks on a Monday and bounce. Tasks hidden by the cap are not counted as missed.
settings.cap: Tasks per day, across all batches
settings.readingHint: Readings earn points once BOTH thresholds are met. Dwell time and scroll depth are a patience signal, not a comprehension one — keep reading points small relative to questions, or the leaderboard measures idling.
settings.gamesHint: A teacher-uploaded game reports its own score, and anyone with devtools can report any number. By default such scores earn completion points only. Turn this on to let the score also earn a proportional bonus — and accept that the leaderboard can then be gamed.
settings.unverified: Let self-reported game scores earn bonus points
